nonce.description: the nonce issued in the registration challenge

proof.description: "b64:" + base64 of the raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature of the ASCII bytes "babilim-challenge-v1\n{site_id}\n{nonce}", produced with the install keypair's private half; the same value GET /wp-json/babilim/v1/challenge?nonce= would return. A malformed or non-verifying proof is rejected with 401 invalid_proof and does not consume the nonce.
